title: Build the SKOS glossary
description: Writes glossary/*.glossary.json (folio-assistant core's folio-glossary/v1): one SKOS concept scheme per source. The toolkit's technical terms, verbatim and authored while the toolkit's licence record stands; the 2009 use-case reports' glossaries as the ingester recorded them (none: the reports' summary names a glossary, the text holds none); and one scheme per iHRIS 4.3.3 code list with default records (notation = record id, prefLabel = name; candidate unless the record carries a definition). SKOS matches come only from the verified ConceptMaps (equal/equivalent to exactMatch), with IRIs built by each publisher's pattern (EU Publications Office country and currency tables, ESCO for ISCO-08) and never dereferenced. Deterministic, from committed inputs; --check fails on stale output. Also emits SKOS JSON-LD (a Python mirror of core's toSkos, held to it by validate-folio.ts) for the site.

inputs.name: toolkit-stages
inputs.description: library/ihris-toolkit/stages/*.json, and the licence record in library/ihris-toolkit/ihris-toolkit.json
